title: Panda wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,38 62,38' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 44,23 56,23' fill='#ff5c8a'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 47,16 53,16' fill='#4fd1ff'/>
  <!-- pom pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='4' fill='#ff5c8a'/>
  <!-- panda head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='30' fill='#f2f2f6'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='34' r='9' fill='#4a4466'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='34' r='9' fill='#4a4466'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='54' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#4a4466'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='54' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#4a4466'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='53' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='53' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='53.5' r='2' fill='#1b2440'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='53.5' r='2' fill='#1b2440'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#4a4466'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 69 Q46 74 42 72' stroke='#4a4466' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 69 Q54 74 58 72' stroke='#4a4466' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='66' r='4' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='66' r='4' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
</svg>
